# Fixture provenance

All files generated by `scripts/generate-fixtures.py` contain original synthetic content and are dedicated to CC0-1.0. No commercial ebooks, Windows fonts or third-party book content are included. The original geometric `Sae Fixture` TrueType font only contains the glyphs used by the `EMBED` marker; it is a resource-loading probe, not a production reading font.

- `core-epub2.epub`, `core-epub3.epub`: 30 chapters, NCX/nav, CJK/English, emphasis, headings, lists, quote, PNG illustration, caption, table spans, wide table, embedded font, in/cross chapter links, note/backlink and external URL.
- `fonts.epub`: minimal embedded-font probe.
- `inline-svg-cover.epub`: original PNG inside an inline SVG `image` with a relative `xlink:href`; regression for common Calibre cover markup. A text-only extraction may correctly contain zero text blocks on this image cover.
- `advanced.epub`: SVG, MathML, Ruby, RTL and float. The actual output must be compared with the source and a trusted reader.
- `vertical.epub`: Japanese vertical writing/Ruby.
- `fixed.epub`: EPUB3 rendition layout + viewport + absolute positioning; not proof that the engine supports it.
- `core.pdf`: 30 original pages with a Times-Roman text layer, simple vector illustration and outline.
- `core-*.txt`: equivalent UTF-8, UTF-16 BOM and GB18030 text, with meaningful blank lines and indentation.
- `core.md`: headings, emphasis, nested list, quote, fenced code, table, local PNG, link and rule.
- `hostile-*.epub`, `invalid-encoding.txt`: intentionally invalid safety inputs; reject or diagnose, never treat them as a supported book.

`manifest.json` records the generated bytes' SHA256 and size. The generator fixes ZIP timestamps and font creation/modification times. These samples do not replace Readium/W3C legal external fixtures or reference-reader comparison. No EPUBCheck conformance claim is made until EPUBCheck is actually run.


`scripts/generate-text-fixtures.py` additionally creates original CC0 `text-utf8.txt`, `text-utf16le.txt`, `text-gb18030.txt` and `reading.md`: streaming decode/paragraph boundaries, matching Chinese text, Markdown code/table/image/headings/internal/external links and inert raw HTML. The main generator calls this helper before refreshing `manifest.json`.
